reviewContext.userProblem: Clicking links in the rendered Markdown preview does not reliably navigate: local links can make the webview navigate away from the app, digit-leading anchors throw in querySelector, encoded filenames containing %23/%3F are mis-split, and mailto links are sanitized to '#'. After following a link there is no way to go Back or Forward to the previous file and scroll position.
requiredOutcomes: Relative (./, ../, subdirectory), URL-encoded (including %23 and %3F), same-file anchor, cross-file anchor and absolute local links navigate in-app to the correct file and position; http(s), mailto and tel links open in the system browser and never inside the webview.
Back and Forward toolbar icon buttons exist in the workspace header, are disabled when there is no history (and in diff mode), and restore the file plus scroll/anchor position.
Keyboard: Cmd+[ / Ctrl+[ and Alt+Left go back; Cmd+] / Ctrl+] and Alt+Right go forward; not triggered while an input, textarea, select or contenteditable has focus.
Mouse buttons 3/4 trigger back/forward where the webview delivers them; actual delivery in macOS WKWebView is recorded during launch verification.

Any successful user open (tree select/confirm/reveal, initial load, Open Files, native open, link) pushes an entry and truncates the forward stack; reload, refresh, watcher snapshots and history restore never push.
History works in single view and pair/compare view; pair { / } pane toggles keep working.
bun run typecheck, bun run test, bun run test:dom, mise run lint, and cargo check/clippy/nextest pass; target/debug/chilla builds and launches per the chilla-post-edit-launch skill.
nonGoals: No history persistence across sessions and no history list UI.
No file: URLs, Windows paths, tel/ftp in Rust link sanitizer, or GitHub duplicate-slug suffix emulation.
No changes to PR diff workspace, EpubPreviewPane, HtmlRenderedPreviewPane, raw HTML sanitizers, media URL rules, Tauri commands, capabilities, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock.
Do not touch or commit pubpage/**, design-docs/references/**, design-docs/specs/design-product-website.md, impl-plans/completed/website-current-features.md, or .riela/**.
constraints: Each worker edits only its plan's writePaths, reads files fresh, and records sha256 before and after each edit in its own plan progress log. Evidence (data only) goes under tmp/link-nav-history-20261119-01/<planId>/<attempt>/ and stays untracked.
Mutating git commands (checkout, restore, stash, reset, add, commit) are forbidden for workers.

Do not hijack Cmd/Ctrl+[ ] or Alt+arrows while an editable element has focus; do not add history actions to the KeymapProvider editable-guard exception list or the key-repeat list; do not conflict with { / } pair toggles.
Percent-decoding happens exactly once after splitting the still-encoded href on the first literal # and ?; decoded text is never re-split (DESIGN-001).
preventDefault is called synchronously for every primary a[href] click in PreviewPane before any await.
Use CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true for cargo; NEXTEST_STATUS_LEVEL=fail NEXTEST_FAILURE_OUTPUT=immediate-final NEXTEST_HIDE_PROGRESS_BAR=1 for nextest. No emojis. No AI attribution in commit messages.
Workspace-wide gates (bun run test, bun run test:dom, mise run lint, cargo clippy/nextest, debug launch) and impl-plans/README.md index update run in serial reconciliation, not per plan.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Pure classifier classifyPreviewLink in src/features/preview/previewLinks.ts plus resolveDocumentPathname in preview-assets.ts that does no splitting or decoding.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: resolveDocumentResource re-splits on literal ?/#, which breaks decoded names like chapter#one.md (review finding DESIGN-001); isolating join/normalize keeps existing media behavior identical.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: findFragmentTarget compares id values (exact, then slugifyHeading fallback) instead of building a CSS selector.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: querySelector(`#${id}`) throws for digit-leading ids such as 2024-notes, and CSS.escape may be missing in jsdom.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Single immutable history (navigationHistory.ts) holding single or pair snapshots, capped at 100 entries, with duplicate-target suppression ignoring scrollTop.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Mirrors browser semantics (push truncates forward stack) and keeps pair view as one snapshot timeline rather than per-pane histories (QA decision).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Push only inside the previewSelectedFile requestId success branch; historyMode 'none' for reload, refresh and restore; pair pushes only from the explicit PairListPane onSelect handler, never from an effect.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: previewSelectedFile returns null on both stale and success paths, so pushing from the return value could record stale requests; effect-driven pushes would fire on restore.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Keymap actions history.back/history.forward with both <D-[>/<C-[>/<A-Left> and <D-]>/<C-]>/<A-Right> defaults; the existing editable guard is relied upon.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Configurable and listed in help; both Ctrl and Cmd variants per QA decision; editable guard prevents hijacking editor keys.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Rust sanitize_markdown_link_url accepts mailto (case-insensitive); media URLs stay http/https/data.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: mailto links rendered as href='#' today; opener:default already permits mailto.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Scroll restore retries via requestAnimationFrame for up to 1000 ms with a run-id cancel counter, then forces a final set.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Content height is not available immediately after async render; cancelling prevents stale restores from overriding a newer navigation.

intentionalTradeoffs: In pair mode a link push happens before PairView confirms the side loaded; on load failure the entry holds the failed path, PairView shows its per-pane error, and Back still restores the prior path (accepted low finding, link-nav-workspace-shell.md:120).

PairListPane open/enter both call onSelect with the same index; Enter on the current pair resets a link-overridden side to the pair's paths; duplicate suppression covers the push. Record the behavior during implementation (accepted low finding, link-nav-workspace-shell.md:150).
A local relative path that looks like a scheme (a:b.md) is ignored by the generic-scheme rule.
Debounced tree previews push history when the debounced preview succeeds (QA decision).
Same-file anchor hops push history entries (QA decision).
supportedEdgeCases: ./b.md, ../a/b.md?x=1#Sec, sub/c.md, my%20doc.md, chapter%23one.md, chapter%3Fone.md#heading, name%253F.md (decoded once), /abs/x.md, #%E6%97%A5, malformed percent sequences kept raw.
https, MAILTO (case-insensitive), tel -> external; javascript:, ftp:, //host, #, empty -> ignored.
Digit-leading anchors (#2024-notes) and slug fallback (a_b -> a-b).
History cap of 100 with index kept on the newest entry; push after Back truncates forward entries.
Middle click and clicks inside [role=dialog] are not handled as navigation.
Diff target active: Back/Forward disabled and history actions are no-ops.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: file: URLs and Windows drive paths.
Guaranteed mouse button 3/4 delivery on platforms whose webview does not deliver them.
residualRisks: The WorkspaceShell integration is large; it relies on the stale-request push guard and on edits staying localized.
Mouse button 3/4 delivery in macOS WKWebView must be recorded during launch verification.
Scroll-restore with rAF retry needs rAF stubs or fake timers in jsdom tests.
